observed_failures: Voxel IoU is only 0.618068 and normalized Chamfer is 0.014386, despite an essentially exact bounding box.
The candidate is watertight and structurally valid, but volume is 3.81% low and surface area is 9.13% high.
High-confidence excess occurs near the forward end at aligned length 0.620-0.750 and height 0-0.141, linked to the rear/front bridge and foot union operation group.
The largest missing region spans aligned length 0.008-0.637, full width, and height 0-0.301, showing that low horizontal mass is distributed incorrectly.
Paired excess-03 and missing-05 localize a displaced lever edge around length 0.715-0.750 and height 0.42-0.59.
The candidate has a coarse faceted rear profile and only 172 mesh triangles versus 462 for the reference, consistent with inaccurate curved surfaces.
root_causes: The top-view wide rectangular feature was misread as two separate transverse pads; it should be modeled primarily as a continuous low platform/body across much of the length.

The full-width lower foot was extended from 0.56 to 0.75, creating substantial excess near the forward end; the drawing and localized evidence support a short full-width pad near approximately 0.617-0.672 with only the narrow central member continuing toward 0.75.
The rear bridge was made too long, ending at 0.20 instead of near the reference-consistent 0.1328 breakpoint.

The central members were modeled 0.070 wide, while symmetric missing regions identify a likely 0.0625 width bounded by x=±0.03125; wide features are closer to 0.234375 and the overall foot width is 0.265625.
The inclined lever outline is displaced and uses an incorrect vertical forward edge through the mid-height region; localized paired regions indicate that edge should be shifted rearward and sloped.
The curved rear housing was approximated with many straight segments and an overly filled side profile, inflating surface area and producing displaced planar surfaces.
reflection.structure_assessment: The file is a healthy, editable, watertight single 3DSOLID with the exact required overall envelope, so the construction pipeline and artifact are sound. The failure is geometric rather than infrastructural: major low-level features are placed and interpreted incorrectly, while the lever and rear curved profile need reconstruction. Existing Boolean lineage is useful at the operation-group level, though the three final unions cannot be distinguished exactly because they were performed in one Core Console job.
reflection.decision_reason: A further iteration is worthwhile because the verifier provides concrete, drawing-consistent breakpoints and localized repair regions. Correcting the continuous platform, shortening both full-width end pads, narrowing the central members, and rebuilding the lever and rear curve should materially improve IoU and Chamfer while preserving the already-correct bounding box and watertight solid.
planned_geometry_changes: Rebuild from the pre-feature construction or from a fresh staged model rather than attempting ambiguous face edits on the final union.

Replace the two long transverse bridge boxes with a continuous low platform matching the large top-view rectangle, using approximately width 0.234375, length breakpoints near 0.132812 and 0.617188, and vertical bounds near 0.070312 and 0.1384.
Restrict the rear transverse overhang to roughly length 0.078-0.132812; remove the current excess from 0.132812 to 0.20.
Replace the current full-width foot spanning 0.56-0.75 with a short pad near 0.617188-0.671875, while retaining a narrow central base member to establish the 0.7500 overall length.
Change narrow central body and lever width from 0.0700 to 0.0625, centered at x=0; retain 0.265625 only for the widest foot feature.
Reconstruct the rear housing with true arcs or a smooth curve and reduce the overly filled upper side-profile area, confirming its silhouette against the right view.

Revise the inclined lever so its mid-height forward edge follows the sloped reference surface localized around length 0.715-0.743 and height 0.43-0.59, while preserving the exact 0.7421 height and 0.7500 overall length.
Isolate each replacement Boolean in its own Core Console stage and verify one remaining 3DSOLID after every union or subtraction.

(if (setq old (ssget "_X")) (command "_.ERASE" old ""))

(defun mkbox (x0 x1 w z0 z1 / e)
  (command "_.UCS" "_W")
  (command "_.BOX" (list x0 (- (/ w 2.0)) z0) "_L" (- x1 x0) w (- z1 z0))
  (entlast)
)

(defun mkxyprof (pts ht / e r)
  (command "_.UCS" "_W")
  (command "_.PLINE")
  (foreach p pts (command p))
  (command "_C")
  (setq e (entlast))
  (command "_.REGION" e "")
  (setq r (entlast))
  (command "_.EXTRUDE" r "" ht)
  (entlast)
)

(defun mksideprof (pts w / e r)
  (command "_.UCS" "_3P" (list 0.0 (/ w 2.0) 0.0) (list 1.0 (/ w 2.0) 0.0) (list 0.0 (/ w 2.0) 1.0))
  (command "_.PLINE")
  (foreach p pts (command p))
  (command "_C")
  (setq e (entlast))
  (command "_.REGION" e "")
  (setq r (entlast))
  (command "_.EXTRUDE" r "" w)
  (command "_.UCS" "_W")
  (entlast)
)

(defun mkarcside (astart acen aend rest w / ea ep ss r)
  (command "_.UCS" "_3P" (list 0.0 (/ w 2.0) 0.0) (list 1.0 (/ w 2.0) 0.0) (list 0.0 (/ w 2.0) 1.0))
  (command "_.ARC" astart "_C" acen aend)
  (setq ea (entlast))
  (command "_.PLINE" aend)
  (foreach p rest (command p))
  (command "")
  (setq ep (entlast))
  (setq ss (ssadd))
  (ssadd ea ss)
  (ssadd ep ss)
  (command "_.REGION" ss "")
  (setq r (entlast))
  (command "_.EXTRUDE" r "" w)
  (command "_.UCS" "_W")
  (entlast)
)

(setvar "CMDECHO" 0)
(setvar "DELOBJ" 1)
(command "_.UCS" "_W")
(if (setq old (ssget "_X")) (command "_.ERASE" old ""))

(defun mkbox (x0 x1 w z0 z1 / e)
  (command "_.UCS" "_W")
  (command "_.BOX" (list x0 (- (/ w 2.0)) z0) "_L" (- x1 x0) w (- z1 z0))
  (entlast)
)

(defun mkxyprof (pts ht / e r)
  (command "_.UCS" "_W")
  (command "_.PLINE")
  (foreach p pts (command p))
  (command "_C")
  (setq e (entlast))
  (command "_.REGION" e "")
  (setq r (entlast))
  (command "_.EXTRUDE" r "" ht)
  (entlast)
)

(defun mksideprof (pts w / e r)
  (command "_.UCS" "_3P" (list 0.0 (/ w 2.0) 0.0) (list 1.0 (/ w 2.0) 0.0) (list 0.0 (/ w 2.0) 1.0))
  (command "_.PLINE")
  (foreach p pts (command p))
  (command "_C")
  (setq e (entlast))
  (command "_.REGION" e "")
  (setq r (entlast))
  (command "_.EXTRUDE" r "" w)
  (command "_.UCS" "_W")
  (entlast)
)

(defun mkarcside (astart acen aend rest w / ea ep ss r)
  (command "_.UCS" "_3P" (list 0.0 (/ w 2.0) 0.0) (list 1.0 (/ w 2.0) 0.0) (list 0.0 (/ w 2.0) 1.0))
  (command "_.ARC" astart "_C" acen aend)
  (setq ea (entlast))
  (command "_.PLINE" aend)
  (foreach p rest (command p))
  (command "")
  (setq ep (entlast))
  (setq ss (ssadd))
  (ssadd ea ss)
  (ssadd ep ss)
  (command "_.REGION" ss "")
  (setq r (entlast))
  (command "_.EXTRUDE" r "" w)
  (command "_.UCS" "_W")
  (entlast)
)

)

(defun mksideprof (pts w / e r)
  (command "_.UCS" "_3P"
    (list 0.0 (/ w 2.0) 0.0)
    (list 1.0 (/ w 2.0) 0.0)
    (list 0.0 (/ w 2.0) 1.0))

  (command "_C")

  (command "_.REGION" e "")
  (setq r (entlast))
  (command "_.EXTRUDE" r "" w)
  (command "_.UCS" "_W")
  (entlast)
)

observed_failures: A012 scores 84.97 because volume error is 0.008621, above the strict 0.005 limit; strict voxel IoU also remains below target at 0.974558.

Despite the score regression, a012 materially improves geometric agreement over a010: IoU rises from 0.959138 to 0.974558, normalized Chamfer falls from 0.003663 to 0.003401, and surface-area error falls from 0.012872 to 0.002442.
The former dominant radius-matched cylindrical missing region disappears after the rear-arc translation, validating the center near 0.171875.

The largest remaining missing patches are bilateral shoulder surfaces at longitudinal positions 0.097–0.133 and lateral positions approximately ±0.031–0.061, with estimated areas 0.004052 and 0.003634.
root_causes: The a012 rear-arc translation removed too much net volume, reducing candidate volume from 0.018524 to 0.018298 versus the 0.018457 target.

The rear-arc parameters are nevertheless supported by the improved IoU, Chamfer, surface area, and disappearance of the cylindrical missing patch; the low score is specifically a volume-balance regression rather than evidence that the arc location is geometrically worse.
The shoulder transition currently ends at width 0.140625 while adjoining a platform of width 0.234375, leaving the bilateral wedges localized by missing-01 and missing-03 absent.

Expanding the shoulder terminal width to the adjoining platform width adds an estimated 0.000150 volume, bringing the predicted total near 0.018448 and addressing both the localized missing surfaces and strict volume failure.
